title: Make the Windows timing tests wait on their condition
goal: The Windows job fails only when behaviour is wrong, not when the runner is slow
acceptance: Each Windows-flaky test of 2026-11-13 (instrumentality F-003 failed night, kaji-link degraded base, worker-link B-046 stall, Telegram language join, windowsServiceAdapter, F-005-T23 update) waits on its condition or carries a Windows budget with a reason
20 consecutive Windows CI runs of those tests pass
The browser start timeout has headroom on the CI runner
escalation: A change to the behaviour a test checks goes to a fresh-context review

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-13: six test waits and one browser timeout, then repeated Windows runs. Not a measurement.
